description: This file provides session management functionalities using a database backend, including session serialization/deserialization, session ID regeneration, session table creation, and a class for establishing and managing database connections and session data operations.

classes.name: ADODB_Session
classes.description: A class for managing database-backed sessions, including connection setup, read/write operations, destruction, and garbage collection.

methods.name: adodb_unserialize
methods.description: Unserializes session data stored via ADOdb, parsing a serialized string into variables.

methods.name: adodb_session_regenerate_id
methods.description: Regenerates the session ID and updates it in the database.

methods.name: adodb_session_create_table
methods.description: Creates the session storage table in the database using a schema file.
